title: Trouble Below
html:
This quest is not fully written yet. Steps, items or dialogue may be missing.Kobolds have dug up into Silverdelve's lower drift from below, and Miner Tobb's crew won't go down there.

About

Given byMiner Tobb
Level21
LengthMedium
KindSide
Quest points1

What you need

Nothing to bring in the steps recorded so far.

Steps

  1. Talk to Miner Tobb (outdoors around -314, -1053) to get the quest.
  2. Kobolds in the lower drift (10)
  3. Report to Miner Tobb at -314, -1051

Rewards

Reward
Gold1,152
Character XP36,000
Quest points1

What Miner Tobb says

Miner Tobb: Ten of them. My crew will believe it when they see it, but they'll go down and look, and that's a start.

Miner Tobb: Quartermaster Ulf has been after me for silver all week, and I've had nobody to dig it. Go and see him.

Handing it in

"Quartermaster Ulf has been after me for silver all week, and I've had nobody to dig it. Go and see him."
